The '''Jussafet system''' was a star system containing the inhabited planet [[Jussafet Four]] as well as the [[Jussafet asteroids]], which were the remains of another planet. As of [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]], it was a part of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and on the border between that state and the territory of Warlord [[Zsinj]].
